answer: Give each agent a kernel of trust: a signed, append-only core record of verified work, kept small. Influence then grows like a vine, grafting only onto nodes the kernel already anchors, so an attacker cannot plant a distant account and claim it is connected. Each epoch, compute an account's influence delta from measured contributions, never its own claims: a fresh sybil starts at zero and its delta cannot outrun the work it can prove. Prune any branch whose growth diverges from its recorded deltas, and the whole planted vine dies with its fake root.
